aboutGame.title: What is Project Rasengan?
paragraphs: Project Rasengan is the official NARUTO franchise revival announced at New York Comic Con 2026. It connects four confirmed projects into one long-term roadmap.

The initiative includes a NARUTO x NINKU limited anime, the new SHADOW RISING manga by Masashi Kishimoto, NARUTO CARD GAME in June 2027, and NARUTO mobile WORLDWIDE. This wiki tracks verified updates only.

faq.title: Project Rasengan FAQ

items.question: What is Project Rasengan?
items.answer: It is the official NARUTO franchise revival initiative announced at New York Comic Con 2026. It connects anime, manga, trading cards and a global mobile game.

items.question: When does the card game launch?
items.answer: NARUTO CARD GAME is confirmed for June 2027 worldwide.

items.question: Is there an official Discord?
items.answer: No dedicated Project Rasengan Discord is confirmed. Follow the official website, X accounts, YouTube channel and Instagram instead.
